reviews.comment: Didn't feel much from one scoop so tried two and got super jittery and anxious. Might just be my sensitivity to caffeine but wasn't a good experience.
Not sure if BCAAs actually do anything for me but this one mixes well and doesn't taste bad. Probably won't repurchase — the science on BCAAs is questionable.
Upsets my stomach a bit even with food. Might be the form of iron. Going to try a different brand.
It's fine. Does the job. Nothing special about the taste honestly, kind of chalky if you don't mix it enough. Probably wouldn't repurchase at this price point.
The cable kinked badly after a week and won't straighten out. Makes it impossible to jump smoothly. Maybe I got a bad one.
Mat started peeling after a month of use. The grip was good at first but the quality didn't hold up. Disappointed for the price.
Worked great for two months then the battery stopped holding a charge. Waiting on warranty replacement. When it worked it was excellent though.
Way too heavy for me even though I'm within the recommended weight range. Felt claustrophobic rather than comforting. Might work for others but not for me.
Mixes incredibly well, no clumps at all. The chocolate flavour is rich without being overly sweet. Been using it for 3 months post-workout and honestly can't go back to the cheaper stuff.
Great protein powder. 25g per scoop is solid and it digests well — no bloating like I got with other brands. Vanilla is nice in smoothies.
Good quality whey but the tub was only about 2/3 full when I opened it. Taste is decent, mixes fine in a shaker. Would buy again but feels a bit overpriced.
Best whey I've tried in years. Mixes clean, tastes great with water or milk. Chocolate is the way to go.
Finally a protein that doesn't make me gag. The vanilla is smooth and not artificial tasting. Been hitting my protein targets way easier now.
Pure creatine, no filler or flavouring. Mixes clear in water. Noticed strength gains within 3 weeks. Exactly what you want from creatine — unflavored, clean, effective.
Does what it says. No digestive issues. I would've liked a scoop included though, had to use my own measuring spoon.
Solid product. Been taking 5g daily and my lifts have gone up noticeably. No water retention issues either.
Switched to this from a big brand and honestly feel the same if not better. One a day, easy to swallow, no weird aftertaste. Good value.
Good basic multi. I like that it's organic. Only complaint is the bottle is quite large for 30 tablets — lots of cotton stuffing.
My energy levels have been more consistent since I started taking these daily. No nausea when taken with food, which was an issue with other brands.
My doctor told me my D levels were low. Started taking these daily and my last bloodwork showed normal levels. Small softgels, easy to take.
Good potency for the price. Living in a cloudy city, I need D3 supplement and these do the job well.
Affordable and effective. I take one with breakfast and my winter mood has definitely improved. Will keep ordering.
No fishy burps! That was my biggest concern and these pass the test. Good EPA/DHA ratio. Capsules are a reasonable size.
Quality fish oil. I just wish the EPA content was a bit higher per capsule. Otherwise no complaints — no aftertaste, easy to swallow.
Been taking for joint health and my knees feel better during squats. The fact that there's no fishy repeat is a huge plus.
It's okay. Definitely getting fish burps occasionally despite the claims. Might need to take with a bigger meal.
Mixes great, tastes refreshing during workouts. I sip this throughout my training sessions and feel less fatigued on long gym days.
Decent BCAA. Helps with recovery I think. The flavour could be stronger though — it's quite subtle even with two scoops.
This gives me a proper kick without the jitters. Clean energy, good pump, no crash afterwards. One scoop is all I need.
Solid pre-workout. Energy hit is clean and lasts the whole session. Wish it mixed a bit better — always some grit at the bottom of the shaker.
Tried so many pre-workouts and this one hits the sweet spot. Not too stimulating but enough to get me going for early morning sessions.
Started taking this during cold season and haven't gotten sick once. Small tablets, easy to swallow. Good form of zinc too.
Seems to help my immune system. Take it with food to avoid nausea. Can't complain for the price.
My skin has cleared up since I started taking zinc regularly. Didn't expect that bonus but happy about it.
This has been a game-changer for my sleep. Take two before bed and I fall asleep faster and wake up less during the night. The glycinate form doesn't upset my stomach either.
Was skeptical but this genuinely helps me wind down at night. No more restless legs, sleep is deeper. Wish I'd found this years ago.
Helps with sleep quality for sure. Only giving 4 stars because the bottle says take 2-3 tablets and at that rate one bottle doesn't last long.
Maybe helps a bit with relaxation but I didn't notice a huge difference in sleep quality. Might need to take it longer.
My iron levels were low and my doctor recommended a supplement. These don't cause constipation like other iron pills I've tried. Energy is back up.
Good iron supplement, vegan-friendly which is important for me. Take with vitamin C for better absorption.
Upsets my stomach a bit even with food. Might be the form of iron. Going to try a different brand.
Can't really 'feel' creatine working but my numbers are going up so I'll trust the process. Powder is very fine, makes a bit of a mess.
It's a multivitamin. Hard to tell if it's doing anything different than what I was taking before. Tablets are a bit large.
The grip on this mat is incredible. No slipping during downward dog even when my hands get sweaty. Cushioning is perfect — not too thick, not too thin.
Nice mat, good cushioning and the blue colour looks great. It did have a bit of a rubber smell for the first week but that's gone now.
Finally a mat that doesn't bunch up or slide around. The non-slip surface is legit. My hot yoga sessions are so much better now.
Thick enough to protect my knees but not so thick that I lose balance. Quality material. The pink is a lovely shade too.
Perfect for my home workout routine and physio exercises. The vinyl coating is comfortable to hold and they don't scratch the floor if I put them down.
Good dumbbells for the price. Colour-coded is handy. Just wish there was a storage rack included.
Exactly what I needed for light toning exercises. Comfortable grip, good weight distribution. No complaints.
Solid build quality. Comfortable grip and the vinyl doesn't get sticky like some cheap ones I've had. Good for my home gym.
Good dumbbells, well balanced. They do feel slightly heavier than 10lb compared to the ones at my gym but that could just be the grip.
Decent but one of the dumbbells has a slight wobble — the weight isn't perfectly centered. Works fine for casual use but noticeable.
Love these! 5 different levels means I can progress as I get stronger. The door anchor attachment is a nice bonus. Great for travel too — takes zero space.
These replaced my gym membership during lockdown and I still use them daily. Versatile, durable, and the included guide is actually helpful.
Good variety of resistance levels. The lightest band snapped after about 6 months of regular use but the others are holding up fine.
The bands are fine but the handles are uncomfortable after extended use. The foam is too thin. Works okay for short workouts.
This thing hurts so good. My back and IT bands have never felt better. Dense foam that holds its shape. A must-have for anyone who trains hard.
Physio recommended I get one of these for my tight calves. Works wonders. Firm enough to actually get into the muscle but not unbearable.
Good density, decent length. The surface texture could be a bit more aggressive for deep tissue work but it's great for general rolling.
Changed my recovery routine completely. Use it every morning on my legs and back. The firmness is perfect — not too soft like cheap ones.
Solid cast iron, smooth handle with no rough edges. The flat bottom is stable for renegade rows. Exactly what a kettlebell should be.
Good kettlebell. The handle is comfortable enough for swings and cleans. A bit of a chip on the paint but doesn't affect functionality.
Perfect weight for my home workouts. Handle is wide enough for two-handed swings. Well balanced and feels durable.
Fast, smooth, and the bearings are quality. Can finally do double-unders consistently. Cable length adjustment is easy and stays put.
Good rope for the price. Very fast. The handles are a bit thin for my liking but manageable. Great for cardio circuits.
Finally gloves that fit well and don't fall apart after a month. Padding in the right places, good grip. The medium fits my hands perfectly.
Comfortable and breathable. Good for preventing calluses. Only complaint is the wrist support wrap could be a bit longer.
Gloves are okay but the sizing runs small. Ordered large and they're tight. Quality is decent otherwise.
Holds air well, good quality material. I use it as a desk chair and for core exercises. The anti-burst rating gives me confidence.
Good ball, sturdy. Comes with a pump which is appreciated. Lost a bit of air after the first week but topped it up and it's been fine since.
Great for my home office setup. Replaced my desk chair with this and my posture has improved. Quality is solid.
Installs easily in a standard doorway and feels rock solid. I'm 85kg and it doesn't budge. Foam grips are comfortable. Great for home workouts.
Good bar, holds my weight fine. The screwless installation works but I was nervous at first. Added the safety screws for peace of mind.
Works but the door frame brackets left marks on my trim. The bar itself is fine but check your door frame width before ordering.
Absolute lifesaver for my sore muscles after heavy training days. Multiple heads for different muscle groups. Battery lasts ages. Worth every cent.
This is the best purchase I've made for recovery. Quieter than my friend's Theragun and just as powerful. The deep muscle head is brutal in the best way.
Powerful and effective but it's heavier than I expected. My wife struggles to hold it for long. Otherwise excellent device.
My physio uses one of these and recommended I get one for home. This model is just as good. My DOMS recovery time has halved.
I'm a nurse on my feet 12 hours a day and these are lifesavers. Graduated compression is just right — my legs aren't achy at the end of a shift.
Good compression level, comfortable to wear all day. They're a bit tricky to get on at first but that's compression socks for you.
Bought these for long-haul flights and they work great. No more swollen ankles. Also use them for post-run recovery.
Compression is decent but the sizing chart was confusing. Ordered medium based on shoe size and they're too tight at the toe. Quality is okay though.
Stays flexible even when frozen so it actually conforms to your body. I use it for my knee after runs. Holds the cold for a good 20-25 minutes.
Does the job. Gel stays pliable when frozen. Just wish the cover was included instead of sold separately.
Simple, effective, cheap. I have three of these in my freezer at all times. The gel material doesn't leak even after hundreds of freeze-thaw cycles.
Heats up fast, covers a good area, and the auto-shutoff is a nice safety feature. Perfect for my lower back pain after long sitting sessions.
Good heat output and the fabric is soft against skin. The controller could be more intuitive — buttons are small and hard to read.
My partner stole this from me because she loves it so much for her period cramps. Going to have to order another one.
Really helps with my chronic lower back pain. Multiple modes and intensity levels. The pads stick well and last a decent amount of time before needing replacement.
Works well for pain relief. Takes some experimentation to find the right pad placement and settings. Instructions could be clearer.
Provides some relief but the pads lose their stickiness quickly. Had to order replacements after 2 weeks. The unit itself works fine.
My chiropractor uses TENS on me and recommended a home unit. This one has good power and the different programs actually feel distinct.
Tore my meniscus last year and this brace gives me confidence to exercise again. The adjustable straps let me dial in the support I need.
Good support for my arthritic knee. Stays in place during walking and light exercise. Gets a bit warm after extended wear.
Fit is customizable and it doesn't slip like other braces I've tried. The hinge provides lateral stability without being bulky.
Rolled my ankle playing basketball and this sleeve provided great compression during recovery. Comfortable enough to wear with shoes.
Good compression and breathable material. Helps with my chronic ankle instability. Would prefer a slightly tighter fit but it does the job.
Compression is okay but the seam at the toe rubs after a while. Might work better for some people but not the most comfortable for all-day wear.
I work in a warehouse and this belt has saved my back. Proper support when lifting and it doesn't dig in like cheaper ones.
Provides solid lower back support. The sizing runs a bit large so check measurements carefully. Build quality is good.
My back pain from sitting at a desk all day has decreased significantly since I started wearing this. Unobtrusive under a shirt.
Post-workout soak with these and I feel brand new. Good quality, dissolves well, no scent which I prefer. 5lb bag lasts ages.
Does what Epsom salts do — muscle relaxation. The bag is a bit annoying to reseal. Product itself is fine.
I soak in these after every long run. My legs feel significantly better the next day. You can feel the difference vs a regular bath.
The menthol kick is strong and immediate. Feels cold then warm and really helps with sore muscles after the gym. Non-greasy which I appreciate.
Good cream, works well for minor aches. Smell is quite strong though — my wife complains about the menthol scent lingering.
Decent temporary relief but the effect doesn't last long. Might as well use a cheaper cream. Texture is nice and absorbs quickly.
Actually tastes good! Most protein bars are chalky but these have a great texture. 20g protein per bar is solid for a snack. Chocolate is the best flavour.
Good bars, not too sweet, decent protein. The peanut butter flavour is a bit dry but the chocolate ones are great. Good for on-the-go.
These have replaced my afternoon coffee and biscuit habit. Keeps me full till dinner. Chewy, tasty, and the macros are decent.
Protein content is good but these are quite calorie-dense for the size. Taste is okay — definitely more 'functional' than 'treat'.
These got me through my marathon training. Easy to digest on the run, not too thick, and the energy kick is noticeable within minutes.
Good gels for endurance work. Consistency is better than most — not too thick or sticky. Only complaint is they're quite sweet.
Tried multiple brands and these sit best in my stomach during long rides. Quick energy without the GI issues.
I sweat a lot during hot yoga and this keeps me from getting headaches afterwards. Mixes easily, tastes refreshing without being too sweet.
Good hydration multiplier. Flavour is pleasant. I use half a scoop sometimes because the full serving is quite intense.
Been using this instead of sports drinks. Way less sugar and actually works better for recovery after intense sessions.
Convenient for busy mornings when I don't have time for breakfast. Fills me up for about 3-4 hours. Taste is okay — drinkable but not delicious.
Best meal replacement I've tried. Mixes smooth, no grit. Keeps me full and the nutritional profile is balanced. Vanilla is the way to go.
Does the job nutritionally but the taste is pretty bland. Works as a last resort meal but I wouldn't drink it for pleasure.
Perfect crunch without being too sweet. Great with yogurt and berries. Love that it's organic and not loaded with sugar like mainstream brands.
This is my go-to breakfast now. Toasted, crunchy clusters, and you can actually taste the oats and honey. Not a sugar bomb like other granolas.
Really good granola. Just a bit pricey for the bag size. Quality is there though — clusters stay crunchy in milk.
Smooth, creamy, and just almonds — no added oils or sugar. The natural oil separation is expected, just stir it. Tastes fresh and clean.
Good quality almond butter. A bit runny compared to others I've had. Needs a good stir when you first open it.
Way better than the big brand stuff. You can taste the difference. Goes perfectly on toast with banana.
Cooks up fluffy with no bitterness. I rinse it once and it's perfect. Great as a base for grain bowls. Organic certification is a plus.
Good quality quinoa. Consistently clean — rarely find any grit or stones like with cheaper brands. Price is fair for organic.
My staple grain. This batch cooks evenly and has a nice nutty flavor. Bulk value is decent.
Fresh, clean seeds. I add them to smoothies, oatmeal, and make chia pudding. They gel up nicely and have no off-flavors.
Good quality chia seeds at a fair price. The bag seal could be better — I transferred to a jar. Product itself is great.
Excellent for adding fiber and omega-3s to my diet. No twigs or debris like I've found in cheaper brands. Will repurchase.
I'm not a fan of the taste of green tea but want the antioxidant benefits. These capsules are easy to take and I feel more energetic since starting.
Seems like a good quality extract. No jittery feeling. I take it with breakfast and it's a nice gentle energy boost.
Haven't noticed much of a difference honestly. Might be doing something internally but no perceivable effect. Capsules are easy to swallow though.
Refreshing and not too sweet. Perfect after a workout or on a hot day. The 12-pack is good value. Tastes like real coconut, not flavored sugar water.
Good coconut water. Slightly sweeter than fresh but very drinkable. Packaging holds up well in shipping.
My go-to post-run hydration. Natural electrolytes without the junk in sports drinks. Will keep ordering the 12-pack.
Runs quietly, covers my whole living room, and the auto-shutoff is a nice safety feature. Looks sleek on my nightstand. Changed my evening routine completely.
Good diffuser, puts out a nice mist. The light is a bit bright even on the lowest setting. Otherwise works great.
I run this every night with lavender oil and my sleep has improved. Very quiet operation. Easy to clean and refill.
Works but the mist output is weaker than my previous one. Fine for a small room but doesn't do much in my open-plan living area.
Pure, strong, and authentic lavender scent. A few drops in the diffuser and the whole room smells like a spa. Calming effect is real.
This is genuine lavender oil, not the synthetic stuff. The scent is herbaceous and true, not overpowering. Great for sleep blends.
Nice oil. The scent is good but seems to dissipate quicker than some premium brands I've used. Good value though.
Finally I can sit for longer than 10 minutes without my legs going numb. Firm support, good angle for the hips. The cover is washable too.
Comfortable and well-made. Filled with buckwheat which I prefer over foam. My only complaint is I wish there were more colour options.
Transformed my meditation practice. No more back pain from sitting on the floor. Quality construction and the buckwheat fill holds its shape.
Actually blocks all light. The silk is gentle on my skin and the adjustable strap doesn't snag my hair. Best sleep mask I've owned.
Comfortable and effective at blocking light. The silk feels nice. Only complaint is it can shift around if you're a side sleeper who tosses.
Game changer for daytime sleeping (shift worker here). Soft, comfortable, and truly blackout. My sleep quality improved noticeably.
The variety of sounds is great — I use the rain setting every night. Helps mask my neighbour's TV noise. Speaker quality is better than expected.
Good selection of sounds. The white noise option is effective. Some of the nature sounds loop noticeably but it doesn't bother me once I'm asleep.
I'm a light sleeper and this has been a lifesaver. Blocks out background noise without being intrusive. Compact enough for travel.
Love the prompts in this journal. They make me think differently about my day. Quality paper, nice binding. Has genuinely improved my mindset.
Good guided journal. The daily structure keeps me consistent. Some prompts repeat which is fine — reinforces the habit.
Started this 2 months ago and it's become my favorite part of the morning. The prompts are thoughtful, not cheesy. Nice quality paper too.
Surprisingly effective. I keep one at my desk and squeeze it during stressful calls. Different densities are nice for variety.
They're fine but the material picks up dust and lint easily. Squeeze feel is decent. Works as a basic stress relief tool.
Good set for the price. The firmness variety is useful. My kids keep stealing them though.
Lovely selection of calming teas. The chamomile is my favorite — smooth and fragrant. Nice packaging too. Made a great gift.
Good variety of caffeine-free teas. Some blends are better than others — the lavender chamomile is excellent. Decent value for the sampler.
My evening wind-down ritual. Each tea bag is individually wrapped and fresh. The stress relief blend genuinely helps me relax before bed.
I was skeptical about weighted blankets but this genuinely helps my anxiety at night. The 15lb feels perfect for my body weight. Sleep deeper now.
Game-changer for my insomnia. Feels like a firm hug. Takes some getting used to but once I did, I can't sleep without it.
Good weight, effective. Only issue is it traps heat — might not work well in summer. The cover is removable for washing which is essential.
I get seasonal affective disorder every winter and this lamp makes a noticeable difference. 30 minutes every morning and my mood is noticeably brighter.
Bright, effective lamp. Compact enough to sit on my desk while I work. Wish the timer had more options but it does the job.
Living somewhere with very short winter days, this has been essential. The light is bright and natural-feeling. Energy and mood improved within a week.
